title: Mini-Usine IoT Dashboard
description: Tableau de bord de supervision pour Mini-Usine IoT

targets.query: from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "production" and r._field == "speed") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "speed")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temperature" and r._field == "temperature") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "temperature")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "production" and r._field == "efficiency") |> last() |> yield(name: "efficiency")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pressure" and r._field == "pressure") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "pressure")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vibration" and (r._field == "vibration_x" or r._field == "vibration_y" or r._field == "vibration_z")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "vibration")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r._field == "power") |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "power")
from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "production" and r._field == "downtime") |> last() |> yield(name: "downtime")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "energy" and r._field == "energy_total") |> last() |> yield(name: "energy_total")
